title: Methanol Independent Expression by Pichia Pastoris Employing De-repression Technologies
protocol: Autoclave 650 mL of distilled water in a 1 L screw cap glass bottle.
Complete the medium by adding 100 mL of autoclaved 10x YNB, 200 mL of potassium phosphate buffer (1 M, pH 6), 30-100 mL of 10% w/v glucose or glycerol, and 2 mL of sterile 500x Biotin solution.
Filter sterilize the Biotin solution with a 0.2 μm membrane filter before adding it to the medium.
Fill up to 1 L with sterile distilled water after adding all components.
Autoclave 700 mL of distilled water with 1% w/v yeast extract and 2% w/v peptone in a 1 L screw cap bottle.
Add 30-100 mL of the separately autoclaved 10% w/v glycerol to the cooled medium.
Add 200 mL of potassium phosphate buffer (1 M, pH 6) to the medium.
Fill up to 1 L with sterile distilled water after adding all components.
Add 5 mL of distilled water in the 250 mL baffled shake flasks.
Cover the flasks with two layers of cotton cloth and fix it in place with rubber bands.
Cover the cloth with a piece of aluminum foil.
Autoclave the flasks at 121 °C for 20 min for full sterilization.
Remove residual water from the flask.
Aliquot 50 mL of the previously prepared media to each flask.
Start an overnight culture with a single fresh colony of the desired expression strain in 5 mL of YPD medium in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Leave the lid of the centrifuge tube slightly open for proper aeration.
Grow the culture overnight at 28 °C, 80% humidity, on a shaker at 100-130 rpm (2.5 cm shaking diameter).
Follow the manufacturer’s instructions to appropriately calibrate the measurement devices.
Install the necessary software for monitoring on a computer and ensure it is within Bluetooth range of the measurement stations.
Turn on the Bluetooth connection on the biomass measuring device by pressing the silver button on the front.
In the software, click Devices then Find Devices.
Drag and drop the found devices to the squares on the right side of the screen Measurement Tray.
Click Connect in the software.
When the connection is successful, a control screen will appear.
To start a test run for the Bluetooth connection, click Measurement in the control screen.
Set up the experiment by clicking Start Measurement.
Name the experiment and enable all parameters needed to monitor.
Set the interval to 3 min for measurement points.
Enter the names for the samples.
Measure the cell density of the ONC diluted in cultivation media (1:20) in a spectrophotometer at 600 nm wavelength.
Inoculate 50 mL of the medium with the ONC to an OD600 of 0.05.
Place the flasks in the detectors and shake at 28 °C, 130 rpm and 80% humidity.
Shake the culture for 5 min before starting the measurement.
Click Start Measurement in the software.
Take 0.2 mL samples for cell density measurement 4 h after inoculation and when the carbon source gets depleted, in triplicates.
Dilute the first set of samples at a ratio of 1:5 with cultivation media.
Measure the diluted samples at a wavelength of 600 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Dilute subsequent sets of samples at a ratio of 1:20 with cultivation media for further measurements.
Pause the measurement in the software before removing the flasks and stopping the shaker.
Wait 5 min of shaking before starting any new measurement.
Cultivate until the carbon source is nearly depleted (approximately 12-20 hours).
Add four feed discs per flask under sterile conditions when the timepoint described in Step 4.6 is reached.
Monitor cultures using an online monitoring system to determine the depletion of the carbon source and ensure cells are in the exponential growth phase.
Continue cultivation for 60-90 h while taking samples every 24 h.
Monitor protein expression by an assay of choice (e.g., Bradford assay, SDS PAGE or activity assays).
Measure cell density during monitoring.
Harvest cultures after 60-90 h cultivation period.
Fill the cultures in 50 mL centrifuge tubes for harvesting.
Centrifuge at 4,000 x g, 4 °C for 10 min to harvest supernatant or cells.
Harvest supernatant (for secreted proteins) by centrifugation.
Harvest cells (for intracellular protein expression) by centrifugation.
Export online measurement data as a spreadsheet file from the software.
Fill 5-10 mL of distilled water to all the flasks for autoclaving.
Autoclave to inactivate remaining cells.
